sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Plastic gear crate (Gear) is a Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A sturdy case containing all the necessary equipment to start a raid.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Sent by Prapor via in-game mail to PMCs who are short on cash.

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: Each crate contains a weapon with fitting weapon mods and ammunition as well as grenades, medical items, a helmet, an armor vest, two chest rigs and a backpack.
